title: Gilgamesh TaskState v1
description: The structured task-state record that is the single audit artefact of one Gilgamesh mission. It supersedes append-only context at long horizons (digest §3): the mission's objective, acceptance signals, environment snapshot, plan, evidenced claims, changed artefacts, externalized verification outcomes, unresolved risks, the bounded loop budget, the capability-authority table state, and the terminal stop_state. Finalized in Attest and shipped as the mission's audit record. Gilgamesh keeps NO permanent memory (R-032): everything gathered lives here and is returned or discarded.

objective.description: The single-sentence mission objective, copied verbatim from the inbound mission-contract.

acceptance_criteria.description: The acceptance signals frozen at Lock. Each names the external oracle that proves it (never self-assessment).

oracle.description: The external verifier that declares pass/fail (test/parser/diff/env-feedback). Never 'self-assessment'.

env_snapshot_ref.description: Reference (path or handle) to the environment snapshot taken in Inventory — the reproducibility anchor, not the environment inlined.

plan.description: The local plan frozen at Lock (steps + dependencies). After Lock, scope may only shrink.

verified_by.description: The acceptance_criteria.id whose oracle proves this step.

claims.description: Evidence-anchored claims. A claim without an external evidence anchor is inadmissible (the Excalipoor rule).

items.description: External evidence anchor: oracle output, path:line, or verification_outcome id.

changed_artifacts.description: Artefacts mutated during Grind — sandbox-relative, PROPOSE-only (never the real tree).

verification_outcomes.description: The externalized verification record (AC-E05): every meaningful mutation passes an external gate. Never self-reported.

unresolved_risks.description: The risk ledger — risks opened at Lock that remain open at Attest.

budget.description: The bounded loop budget (AC-E07, R-031). A mission that exhausts any dimension terminates via the stopping policy.

authority.description: The instantiated capability-authority table state for this mission (default column plus any granted escalations).

failure_counters.description: Mechanical counters that drive the stopping-policy transitions in Grind.

stop_state.description: The current stopping-policy state (AC-E06). The set is closed to exactly these four members.

handoff_requests.description: Typed delegation requests PROPOSEd upward for the orchestrator to route (AC-E09). Gilgamesh NEVER dispatches or spawns.
